pages.title: Rusted Delver's Head
pages.text: Smith it onto a diamond pickaxe. Found in abandoned mineshafts, more often deep down.

pages.title: Dormant Delver's Pick
pages.text: Throw it through a Nether portal to wake it.

pages.title: Delver's Pick
pages.text: Mines a 1x3 line; sneak to mine one block.
Smith the Rusted Delver's Head onto a diamond pickaxe to get the Dormant Delver's Pick. Throw that through a Nether portal and it comes back awake, enchantments and all.
